stem:
A student is helping a teacher move a bookcase. The student pushes on the bookcase, but the bookcase does not move.

Which action should the student take in order to move the bookcase?

options.label: A
options.text: Apply more force to one side of the bookcase

options.label: B
options.text: Apply more downward force to the bookcase

options.label: C
options.text: Apply less force to the bookcase

options.label: D
options.text: Apply equal force to all sides of the bookcase
